research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Dewpoint Therapeutics is researching methods of characterizing condensate-associated characteristics of compounds, including determining partition characteristics in target condensates. They are developing approaches for screening compounds that affect the association of macromolecules with condensates and identifying condensate phenotypes linked to disease. Their work also includes identifying interactions between compounds and condensates, highlighting a focus on biomolecular condensate-targeted drug discovery.

overview_description.description:
Dewpoint Therapeutics is a biotech company developing a drug platform that targets biomolecular condensates. Its technology uses machine-learning-based image analysis tools for visualizing condensates and offers an engine for genetically linked condensatopathy which is a collection of engineered cell lines with trackable condensates to prevent harmful protein sequestration, helping healthcare providers to have access to new therapies to address unmet needs.

The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts.
